description: Loss of the 2'-deoxyribose sugar moiety from a 2'-deoxynucleoside-derived DNA adduct precursor ion, yielding the free (modified) base ion. General nucleoside CID fragmentation pattern, not specific to one nucleobase.
citation: Deoxyribose loss (C5H8O4, delta 116.0473 Da) is the canonical nucleoside->base CID transition; see docs/landscape.md sec 5 (8-oxo-dG reference case) and its cited sources.

description: First sequential CO loss from the protonated 8-oxoguanine base ion (m/z 168 -> 140).
citation: 8-oxo-dG diagnostic ions m/z 140/112 via sequential CO loss; see docs/landscape.md sec 5.

description: Second sequential CO loss from the 8-oxoguanine fragment ion (m/z 140 -> 112).
citation: 8-oxo-dG diagnostic ions m/z 140/112 via sequential CO loss; see docs/landscape.md sec 5.

description: AFB1-N7-guanine adduct: N7(guanine)-C8(AFB1) bond cleavage retaining charge on the guanine side, i.e. loss of the AFB1-derived C17H12O7 fragment, yielding protonated guanine (m/z ~152). Targeted by candidate id, not nucleobase origin, because this fragmentation is specific to the AFB1-N7-Gua conjugate, not to guanine-derived adducts in general.
citation: Jaruga et al., ACS Omega 2023, 8(16):14841-14854, doi:10.1021/acsomega.3c01328 (open text: PMC10134230). m/z 152/329 complementary fragment pair from N7(Gua)-C8(AFB1) bond cleavage; see docs/landscape.md sec 5.

description: AFB1-N7-guanine adduct: complementary cleavage channel retaining charge on the AFB1 side, i.e. loss of neutral guanine (C5H5N5O), yielding a protonated AFB1-diol fragment (m/z ~329).
citation: Jaruga et al., ACS Omega 2023, 8(16):14841-14854, doi:10.1021/acsomega.3c01328 (open text: PMC10134230).

description: AFB1-FapyGua (ring-opened formamidopyrimidine adduct): loss of H2O from the protonated precursor, a dehydrative re-closure toward an N7-Gua-like ion. Note: this numerically coincides with AFB1-N7-Gua's own [M+H]+ mass -- a known isobaric-fragment ambiguity between these two related adducts that this rule set does not disambiguate on its own.
citation: Jaruga et al., ACS Omega 2023, 8(16):14841-14854, doi:10.1021/acsomega.3c01328 (open text: PMC10134230).

description: AFB1-FapyGua: sequential loss of H2O and CO from the protonated precursor -- decarbonylation of the ring-opened formamide group, the classic Fapy-adduct CID signature.
citation: Jaruga et al., ACS Omega 2023, 8(16):14841-14854, doi:10.1021/acsomega.3c01328 (open text: PMC10134230).
